statement: When the § 422(a) requirements are met, no income results for regular tax purposes at the time stock is transferred on exercise of an incentive stock option (26 U.S.C. § 421(a)(1)); the regular-tax basis is the exercise price and gain or loss is recognized on later disposition.
caveat: Regular tax only: the exercise spread is an AMT adjustment in the year of exercise (rule us-fed.iso-amt-adjustment), and a disposition inside the § 422(a)(1) holding periods converts the treatment (rule us-fed.iso-holding-periods-disqualifying). ISO qualification itself (plan, employee status, 10-year term, exercise price at or above grant-date FMV, employment continuity) has conditions this repo does not verify.
